messages:
maya: quick check — vendor says there's an apac rack with two SKU options: H100 (preemptible) or A100 (reserved). We have a short customer demo tomorrow, ~3h, low concurrency. Which should I claim? cc @sam @priya
sam: If it's 3h and latency matters, H100 is ideal but preemptible risk. How critical is uninterrupted runtime? :thinking:
maya: low concurrency but can't tolerate a full 10–15m outage during demo. prefer low-latency, so leaning A100 if feasible.
priya: For 3h I'd still try 2x H100 preemptible + fallback route — cheaper and faster, but need a fallback to a quantized A40/A100 in another region. Also we must confirm project quota before claiming.
alex: @ops-bot can you run a quick quota check for project:redwood-demo in apac-east1? command i used: `gcloud compute quotas describe --region=apac-east1 --project=redwood-demo --format=json`
ops-bot: Quota scan complete — project:redwood-demo currently: H100 quota 0 (used 8/8), A100 quota 4 (used 0/4), preemptible H100 spots available pending vendor approval: 2. Details: https://internal.vendor/alloc/12345
liam: I can ask staging to release 2 preemptible H100s; need cost center change and brief invoice hold. Pinged vendor already.
sam: If vendor can hold invoice we can take preemptible H100. Otherwise claim A100s. Also open a quick CR to bump reserved pools so automation picks up the new lease (cc @engineering-leases).
maya: I'll open the CR now and tag @priya for config. Drafting terraform snippet:
```
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "demo" {
  region = "apac-east1"
  sku = "h100-preemptible"
  count = 2
  duration_hours = 3
  fallback = "a40-quantized:apac-west1"
}
```
priya: LGTM — add a canary policy to route 100% to fallback if preempted for >30s. Also include health-checks for latency degradation.
sam: also confirm the model artifacts are pre-baked onto A40 fallback (prompt cache + KV warm). PR should reference model-bake job id.
maya: vendor contact (cloudrack): sarah@cloudrack.com — she replied "can hold units for 4h with invoice pending". I've looped in finance (tess).
tess: Finance here — can approve up to $2,500 for this demo if cost center id=cc-123 is on the invoice. Please add the cost center to the PO and notify me once invoice draft is ready.
maya: will do. Summary: attempting to claim 2x preemptible H100 held by vendor, open CR to reserve and add fallback -> pr #42 (will post link), finance to confirm invoice cc-123. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
